svg.title: How a shared Muse page became findable
svg.desc: Diagram of how a shared Muse page became findable. Five connected steps: you ask Muse to share a conversation; Muse creates a page whose web address is built from the conversation's title; the recipient opens the link, resolving the full hostname; a passive-DNS provider records the hostname in a searchable index; anyone can query the index and titles appear in plain text. Two note cards mark the Claroc finding and Meta's pause-and-restore timeline.

text.tspan: HOW A SHARED MUSE PAGE BECAME FINDABLE
A “private by link” share — and how it was found.
You ask Muse to share a conversation
its address uses the conversation’s title plus a random string
A passive-DNS provider records the hostname
The random string was never guessed — the hostname itself is the record.
